guarantees.claim: When !rst_ni, iv_q is assigned '0 on the negedge of rst_ni.
When rst_ni is high, on posedge clk_i, for each i=0..NumSlicesCtr-1 where iv_we[i] == SP2V_HIGH, iv_q[i] is updated from iv_d[i].
When rst_ni is high and iv_we[i] != SP2V_HIGH, iv_q[i] retains its previous value (no assignment).

assumptions.claim: External logic must drive iv_we[i] with the constant SP2V_HIGH to enable a write to iv_q[i].
assumptions.cond: When a write to IV is intended
assumptions.risk: If iv_we[i] is driven with an incorrect value, the IV register may not update, causing reuse of stale IV and breaking encryption freshness.

uncertain_points.claim: If iv_we[i] has legal values other than SP2V_HIGH that should trigger a write (e.g., a multi-bit encoding with multiple asserted states), those values will silently result in hold instead of update.
uncertain_points.cond: When iv_we[i] takes one of those unspecified values while rst_ni is high.
uncertain_points.risk: IV may not be updated as intended, leading to incorrect AES operation and potential output exposure.
